tagline: Scholarship: cross-entity queries over the catalogue, one button to a study
role: The Referee catalogues thinkers, journals and topics and answers cross-entity queries (a query resolves to a set of papers, the same shape as a bundle in the stacks). Its Study lane contract (compose a brief → POST a run → signed webhook back) is the button by which other organs are commissioned from inside a query.
contributes: cross-entity query → paper set (the bundle shape)
the Study lane button contract (HMAC webhooks)
referee grounding and archive for the search loop
